evidence.notes: Local EventBus callback publish queues success callbacks for platform events that carry EventUuid.
Local EventBus callback publish queues success callbacks for platform events that carry EventUuid.
Test.getEventBus().deliver drains queued local platform events and runs after-insert platform event triggers.
Test.getEventBus().fail marks queued callback publishes so Test.stopTest routes them to EventPublishFailureCallback.
Local test event service converts the payload map into a queued platform event for TestBroker delivery.

source.content: public class PublishCallback implements eventbus.EventPublishSuccessCallback, eventbus.EventPublishFailureCallback { public static Integer successCount = 0; public static Integer failureCount = 0; public static String lastFailureUuid; public void onSuccess(eventbus.SuccessResult result) { successCount = result.getEventUuids().size(); } public void onFailure(eventbus.FailureResult result) { failureCount = result.getEventUuids().size(); if (failureCount > 0) { lastFailureUuid = result.getEventUuids()[0]; } } }

trigger EventRecipesDemoTrigger on Event_Recipes_Demo__e (after insert) { for (Event_Recipes_Demo__e evt : Trigger.new) { if (evt.AccountId__c != null) { Account account = [SELECT Id, Website FROM Account WHERE Id = :evt.AccountId__c LIMIT 1]; account.Website = evt.Url__c; update account; } } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeEventBusCallbacksTest { @isTest static void callbackPublishUsesEventUuid() { PublishCallback.successCount = 0; PublishCallback.failureCount = 0; Event_Recipes_Demo__e event = (Event_Recipes_Demo__e) Event_Recipes_Demo__e.SObjectType.newSObject(null, true); System.assertNotEquals(null, event.EventUuid); Test.startTest(); Database.SaveResult single = EventBus.publish(event, new PublishCallback()); System.assert(single.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> many = EventBus.publish(new List<SObject>{event}, new PublishCallback()); System.assertEquals(1, many.size()); System.assert(many[0].isSuccess()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, PublishCallback.successCount); System.assertEquals(0, PublishCallback.failureCount); } @isTest static void testBrokerDeliverRunsPlatformEventTrigger() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Event Account'); insert account; Test.startTest(); EventBus.publish(new Event_Recipes_Demo__e(AccountId__c = account.Id, Url__c = 'https://example.test')); Account beforeDeliver = [SELECT Website FROM Account WHERE Id = :account.Id LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals(null, beforeDeliver.Website); Test.getEventBus().deliver(); Account afterDeliver = [SELECT Website FROM Account WHERE Id = :account.Id LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals('https://example.test', afterDeliver.Website); Test.stopTest(); } @isTest static void testEventServicePublishEventQueuesTriggerDelivery() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Event Service Account'); insert account; Test.startTest(); eventbus.TestEventService.publishEvent('Event_Recipes_Demo__e', new Map<String,Object>{'AccountId__c' => account.Id, 'Url__c' => 'https://event-service.test'}); Account beforeDeliver = [SELECT Website FROM Account WHERE Id = :account.Id LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals(null, beforeDeliver.Website); Test.getEventBus().deliver(); Account afterDeliver = [SELECT Website FROM Account WHERE Id = :account.Id LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals('https://event-service.test', afterDeliver.Website); Test.stopTest(); } @isTest static void testBrokerFailRoutesFailureCallback() { PublishCallback.successCount = 0; PublishCallback.failureCount = 0; Event_Recipes_Demo__e event = (Event_Recipes_Demo__e) Event_Recipes_Demo__e.SObjectType.newSObject(null, true); String uuid = event.EventUuid; Test.startTest(); EventBus.publish(event, new PublishCallback()); Test.getEventBus().fail(); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(0, PublishCallback.successCount); System.assertEquals(1, PublishCallback.failureCount); System.assertEquals(uuid, PublishCallback.lastFailureUuid); } }
